card.title: How To Fix iPhone X That Is Bootlooping Error 4013

source.title: How To Fix iPhone X That Is Bootlooping Error 4013

claims.statement: iPhone X bootlooping with error 4013 (3uTools fails ~19%) is almost always the earpiece flex with a liquid-damaged flood illuminator/ALS; unplug all flexes to confirm.
The earpiece flex is paired for Face ID; to keep Face ID clean or move the components to a new flex.
Otherwise liquid corrosion under the interposer on the bottom board; reflow may clear it, else bottom board swap.

procedure: Unplug all flexes; test with known-good screen, battery, port.
Repair or replace the earpiece flex (preserve flood illuminator/ALS for Face ID).
If still looping, split and test with known-good bottom board; reflow corrosion or swap bottom board.
Exit recovery with 3uTools and retry the update.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
